last.verdict: Raised outlook and a huge record backlog outweighed F-35 funding worries.

reasons.label: Guidance raised again
reasons.text: Second straight raise: 2026 EPS now about $30.35–$30.75, from $29.95–$30.65.

reasons.label: Record backlog
reasons.text: Backlog jumped 27% in one quarter to $292 billion, led by a giant PAC-3 missile award.

reasons.label: Cash flow upgrade
reasons.text: Full-year free cash flow outlook lifted to $7.8–$8.0 billion from $7.0–$7.2 billion.

story: Lockheed has moved from a Q1 revenue and earnings miss (shares fell) to back-to-back guidance raises. The stock rose about 6% after January's outlook and about 11% after July's, and now about 7%. Missile demand drives growth, while F-35 contract timing remains a watch item.
